scope: The reviewed switch of teammate calls (ADR-0037 item 9; its implementation plan's PR 2 commits it off, replacing specialists-staging.json; tool catalogue version 4 per ADR-0041 item 24, plan row H5): Morrow's orchestration tools agent.ask (ask, review and follow-ups), agent.map, agent.message and agent.cancel, and a called teammate's run (result.write and run.complete's child form). While off, packages/policy's coordinatorLaunchTools leaves those four tools out of Morrow's contexts, and edge:check refuses an on record. It goes on by one reviewed commit only after G9 and G10, the agent-loop switch (ADR-0027 item 11) and a passing eval round (ADR-0037 item 10), with its own prerequisites recorded. Hand-offs (agent.route) stay under the agent-loop switch. Production has no switch before the production custody ADR.
